name: 09-calibration-restart-and-cancel
description: Simulated, 30 fps, no noise: shallow quick dips during the first 3-2-1 make it restart ("holdStill", a second countdownTick 3); a deep dip makes the plank gate fail long enough to cancel it (countdownCancelled, back to waiting); then a still plank calibrates and two reps count. targetReps 30.
